title: Compare entropy under a bounded change of probability law
source_anchor: Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling, August20 2026, §2.3.1, printed pp60–61: supporting core only
target_statement: Let μ and ν be probability measures on the same measurable space. If b ≥ 0, ν ≤ b μ, and g is nonnegative μ-almost everywhere with g and g log g μ-integrable, then Ent_ν(g) ≤ b Ent_μ(g). Integrability under ν is derived, including the zero-mean case.
